text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lunch break. Daiichi Ruby was looking for an open seat
to quietly eat lunch alone today as well, but...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...It looks quite crowded.
Nothing we can do. Let's head to the school store—

text_block_list.name: School Store Lady
text_block_list.text: Sorry~! The bento boxes were completely sold out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, she kept waiting for a seat to open up,
but none ever did. Thus, Daiichi Ruby ended up missing lunch entirely.
